nights.title: Swapmeet
nights.name: Swapmeet
nights.extract: Swapmeet is an Australian indie rock band formed in Adelaide in 2022. The group consists of guitarists and drummers Maxwell Elphick and Jack Medlyn, lead vocalist and guitarist Venus O’Broin, and bassist Joshua Doherty.

nights.title: Grace Cummings
nights.name: Grace Cummings
nights.extract: Grace Cummings is an Australian singer-songwriter and stage actor. She has released four studio albums: Refuge Cove (2019), Storm Queen (2022), Ramona (2024), and Bloodhorse! (2026).
